brief:
Israeli forces killed a man and wounded several others in two separate attacks across Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. In Nuseirat camp in central Gaza, a reconnaissance aircraft fired two missiles at a motorcycle, resulting in the death of resident Sobhi Sami Shahtout. The strike marked one of multiple incidents targeting civilians in the densely populated displacement camp.

A second strike struck Gaza City in the northern part of the enclave, adding to mounting casualties from the day's operations. The back-to-back attacks underscored the continued intensity of Israeli military operations across different sectors of the territory, affecting both the central camp area and urban zones.
